reform_history.event: First Service Contract Round — Rumaila Zubair West Qurna
reform_history.notes: Iraq Ministry of Oil launched Bid Round 1 for 8 mature fields under technical service contracts. Government retains title; contractors receive fee per barrel above baseline.
reform_history.source: Iraq Ministry of Oil; IEA Iraq Energy Outlook 2012

reform_history.event: KRG oil exports direct - federal revenue crisis
reform_history.notes: Kurdistan Regional Government began exporting oil directly via Turkey (Ceyhan pipeline), bypassing Baghdad. Federal government withheld budget transfers. Created legal dispute over TSC payment obligations and cost recovery for KRG vs federal contracts.
reform_history.source: KRG Ministry of Natural Resources; Reuters Iraq oil exports 2014; IEA Iraq report 2015

reform_history.notes: Federal Supreme Court ruling on oil export revenue sharing. Ongoing negotiation between KRG and Baghdad over Kurdistan budget transfers.
reform_history.source: Iraqi Federal Supreme Court Decision 2022; Reuters reporting 2023
